create_export_folder_as_dduf: export a folder containing model files into a compressed DDUF archive
create_export_entries_as_dduf: export a list of entries as a DDUF archive with model_index.json and model files
create_read_dduf_file: read a DDUF file and return a dictionary of DDUFEntry objects for each archive member
test_validate_dduf_entry_name: validate that a DDUF entry name has a valid extension and no nested directories
test_validate_dduf_structure: validate that a DDUF archive structure matches its model_index.json manifest
